name: Air-cooled chiller package

design.materialOfConstruction: Carbon steel with inhibitor/oxygen control in closed loops; 316L where open/chloride-elevated; Ti Grade 2 heat-transfer surfaces where required

operatingEnvelope.status: Draft PFD range; no selected setpoint or live measurement
operatingEnvelope.supplyTemperatureC: Chilled water 5–7 °C as drawn; the plant's exotherm control lives here — coincident load 2–3 of 4 R-201 reactors dosing (0.3–1 MW per reactor bounded, not known; calorimetry A-059 is the gating measurement) plus jacket chill-downs

reviewFindings: No approved peak/normal loads, batch simultaneity, exchanger UA or fouling basis is indexed.
Flow, pressure, pressure loss, NPSH, relief, expansion volume and equipment ratings remain unapproved.
Draft ranges are 80–95/60–80 °C HW, 25–30/35–40 °C CW and 5–7/10–15 °C CHW; illustrated values are not operating setpoints.
Four TCUs use heat-transfer barriers; media, pressure hierarchy, leak detection and contamination response are unresolved.
The 10 °C process target is only 3–5 K above draft chilled-water supply across two heat-transfer barriers.
A/B pump geometry does not establish 2 × 100% capacity; shared systems receive no emergency-cooling credit.
HX-601 remains isolated and unassigned; draft hot water cannot provide the cited 140–145 °C dryer inlet by ordinary heat exchange.
Spray-water makeup, treatment, blowdown and winterization remain separate unresolved systems.
CP-5000 is indication intent only; I/O, trips, setpoints and validated live data are absent.

identity.designConcept: Four loops, not three: ≥ 200 °C steam / thermal-oil (3–7 MW at 5 wt % dryer feed; 15–20 MW if 1 wt % is retained), hot water, cooling water, chilled water — duties from Reports 021–042

operatingEnvelope.status: Draft PFD range; no selected setpoint or live measurement
